stories.title: Ukrainian Conti Ransomware Developer Sentenced to 4 Years in US Prison
stories.description: Oleksii Oleksiyovych Lytvynenko has been sentenced to 4 years in prison after he was arrested in Ireland in 2023.

stories.title: cPanel ConfigServer Security & Firewall Vulnerability Allows Remote Attacker to Execute Arbitrary Commands
stories.description: A critical CSF vulnerability could allow unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary commands remotely via the MESSENGER service on cPanel and WHM servers.

stories.title: Check Point Patches Critical VPN Vulnerabilities
stories.description: Tracked as CVE-2026-85102 and CVE-2026-85103, the flaws could be exploited for remote code execution.

stories.description: Financials have not been disclosed, but the estimated cost is in the tens of millions of dollars.

stories.description: IDScan.net, a Louisiana-based identity verification firm whose technology underpins age and identity checks for retailers, bars, and other Fortune 500 clients, has confirmed a data breach after a criminal marketplace began advertising more than 153 million…

stories.title: Surfshark Systems Targeted by Hackers
stories.description: A misconfigured test server containing engineering material, including internal configurations, was accessed by threat actors.

stories.title: Hackers Deploy New SloppyRAT via ClickFix to Enable Ransomware Lateral Movement
stories.description: SloppyRAT uses ClickFix to help ransomware attackers gain access, gather data, and spread across compromised networks.

stories.title: GitLab Patches Critical Flaws Enabling Arbitrary File Read, Credential Theft and Remote Code Execution
stories.description: GitLab has patched multiple flaws, including two critical vulnerabilities enabling arbitrary file reads and credential theft.

stories.title: Attackers Chain JFrog Artifactory Flaws to Gain Admin Control and Plant Backdoors
stories.description: Attackers chained two JFrog Artifactory flaws on unupdated servers to gain admin control, while a third flaw was exploited separately.

stories.title: China-Linked UNC3569 Exploited Sogou Input Method Flaw to Deploy GRAYRABBIT Backdoor
stories.description: China-linked UNC3569 exploited a Sogou Input Method flaw to deploy GRAYRABBIT; Tencent fixed the issue in version 16.3.0.3498.

stories.title: PaperCut Replaces Emergency Patches With Fixes for Two Actively Exploited Flaws
stories.description: PaperCut releases maintenance updates replacing emergency patches for two actively exploited flaws used to break into at least 395 organizations.

stories.title: Cisco FMC Flaws Exploited to Steal Credentials and Deploy Qilin Ransomware
stories.description: Cisco says three threat clusters exploited two patched FMC flaws to gain access, steal credentials, and deploy Qilin ransomware.
